questions.question:
The Pod `api-crash` in `cka-crashloop` repeatedly restarts. Inspect its status and logs to identify why it exits.

Replace it with a Pod of the same name using `busybox:1.37.0` and the command `sh -c 'sleep 3600'`. Ensure it is Running and Ready.

Suggested time: 6 minutes. Marks: 20.

verification.description: Pod was corrected and is Running and Ready

questions.question:
The Deployment `catalog` in `cka-image` has no available replicas. Use its Pod events to find the image problem.

Update it to use `nginx:1.27.5` and ensure both replicas are Ready.

Suggested time: 6 minutes. Marks: 20.

verification.description: Deployment uses the correct image and both replicas are Ready

questions.question:
Clients cannot reach the `payments` Service in `cka-service`. The `payments` Deployment has two Ready Pods. Inspect the Service selector and its endpoints, then correct the issue so the Service selects both Pods.

Suggested time: 6 minutes. Marks: 20.

verification.description: Service selects both Ready Deployment Pods

questions.question:
The `worker-check` Deployment in `cka-scheduling` has a Pending Pod. Inspect the Pod's scheduling events and remove the invalid scheduling constraint from the Deployment.

Ensure its replica is Running and Ready.

Suggested time: 6 minutes. Marks: 20.

verification.description: Invalid node selector is removed and the replica is Ready

questions.question:
The `web-check` Deployment in `cka-readiness` has a Running Pod that is not Ready. Inspect the readiness probe and fix its HTTP path so it matches the endpoint served by the container.

Ensure the replica becomes Ready.

Suggested time: 6 minutes. Marks: 20.

verification.description: Readiness probe uses the working endpoint and the replica is Ready
